about: After Sign-Off Facebook Reels schedule. Times are Philippine time (+08:00). Edit freely; run `npm run check` after editing.

episodes.story: Do Not Look at the Moon

facebook.caption:
If you hear this alert, do not look at the moon

If this alert ever comes on your TV, close your curtains. Now.

Watch the street in the first five seconds. Then watch the clock. 👁️

Broadcast 01 · After Sign-Off. Original fiction.
#analoghorror #emergencyalert #horror #scary #creepy #reels

He hijacked two TV channels in one night. No one knows who.

November 22, 1987. Chicago. A man in a rubber mask cut into two TV broadcasts in one night. He was never identified.

Check the VCR. Then check the coffee table. 📺

Broadcast 02 · After Sign-Off. True story (the 1987 Chicago signal intrusions), recreated in low-poly 3D. No real broadcast footage or audio is used.
#analoghorror #unsolved #truestory #maxheadroom #80s #reels

Footprints led to the house. None led away.

Bavaria, 1922. Tracks in the snow led from the forest to a lonely farm. None led away. Then the farmer heard footsteps in the attic.

Watch the attic window in the very first second. 🕯️

Broadcast 03 · After Sign-Off. True story (the unsolved Hinterkaifeck case), recreated in low-poly 3D. Nothing violent is shown.
#unsolved #unsolvedmysteries #truestory #analoghorror #history #reels

Rules for the night shift at a mountain weather station

Kestrel Ridge Weather Station. You're alone up here until morning. Follow the rules.

Did you read rule 7 before it was read to you? 📋

Broadcast 04 · After Sign-Off. Original fiction.
#analoghorror #rulehorror #nightshift #horror #creepy #reels

Nine hikers cut their tent open from the inside

February 1959, the northern Urals. Nine experienced hikers cut their tent open from the inside and walked into the snow in their socks.

Count the lines of footprints. 👣

Broadcast 05 · After Sign-Off. True story (the Dyatlov Pass incident), recreated in low-poly 3D. Nothing violent is shown.
#dyatlovpass #unsolvedmysteries #truestory #analoghorror #history #reels

Our sonar picked up our own submarine. Behind us.

300 metres down, the contact behind us had our exact sound. Same propeller. Same rattle.

Watch the wide shot before the reveal. Who's standing next to him? 👀

Broadcast 06 · After Sign-Off. Original fiction.
#analoghorror #submarine #horror #scary #creepy #reels

episodes.story: This Is the Voice of Vrillon

facebook.caption:
In 1977, a voice took over the evening news

26 November 1977, southern England. During the early evening news, the sound on one transmitter was replaced for about six minutes by a calm, distorted voice that said it was not from Earth. The picture never changed. The station apologised; the authorities called it a hoax. No one was ever identified.

Watch the clock. Then watch the child. 👀

Broadcast 07 · After Sign-Off. True story (the Southern Television broadcast interruption), recreated in low-poly 3D. No original broadcast audio is used.
#analoghorror #unsolved #truestory #broadcastintrusion #horror #reels

My thermal camera found a warm room that isn't on the plans

Empty house. No power, no heating. One wall upstairs reads 37 °C on my thermal camera. On the plans there's nothing behind it.

Watch the carpet in the thermal shots. Then count the windows. 👀

Broadcast 08 · After Sign-Off. Original fiction.
#analoghorror #thermalcamera #horror #scary #creepy #reels

Three lighthouse keepers vanished. One left his coat.

December 1900. A lighthouse in the Flannan Isles, off the west of Scotland, went dark. Storms kept the relief boat away for eleven days. When it landed, all three keepers were gone. One set of oilskins was still on its hook.

Look at the kitchen. Then look down the path in the last shot. 🕯️

Broadcast 09 · After Sign-Off. True story (the Flannan Isles lighthouse), recreated in low-poly 3D. Nothing violent is shown.
#unsolvedmysteries #lighthouse #truestory #analoghorror #scotland #reels

episodes.story: The Night the Lake Breathed Out

facebook.caption:
In one night, this lake breathed out

21 August 1986, Cameroon. Late at night, Lake Nyos released a huge cloud of carbon dioxide. Heavier than air, it flowed down the valleys below. 1,746 people died that night. Today, pipes draw the gas up from the bottom of the lake.

Watch the lamp in the window. Then listen. 🌫️

Broadcast 10 · After Sign-Off. True story (the Lake Nyos disaster), recreated in low-poly 3D. No people are shown.
#lakenyos #truestory #science #analoghorror #cameroon #reels

Huwag kang titingin sa salamin sa Balete Drive

Balete Drive, New Manila, Quezon City. Mula pa noong dekada singkwenta, iisa ang kuwento ng mga taxi driver: isang babaeng nakaputi sa tabi ng puno ng balete, pumapara. Hindi mahalaga kung huminto ka o hindi.

Tingnan mo ang upuan sa likod sa unang segundo. 👻

Broadcast 11 · After Sign-Off. Kilalang urban legend sa Pilipinas, ginawa sa low-poly 3D. Walang totoong biktimang natukoy kailanman.
#BaleteDrive #WhiteLady #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #urbanlegend #reels

Pag humihina ang tunog… lumalapit siya

Sabi ng matatanda: kapag malakas ang "tik-tik," malayo pa. Kapag mahina na… nasa bubong mo na. Isang gabi ng pista, nagbuhos si Lola ng asin sa bintana. Kinaumagahan, nakakalat ang asin. Mula sa loob.

Gamitin ang headphones. 🎧 Pakinggan kung saan galing ang huling "tik."

Broadcast 12 · After Sign-Off. Original na kuwento (fiction), batay sa paniniwala tungkol sa tiktik.
#tiktik #aswang #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #pinoyfolklore #reels

Kapag may nakita kang kalahating babae… hanapin mo ang asin

Sa Visayas, sabi nila, may mga babaeng dalawa ang buhay. Sa araw, kapitbahay. Sa gabi, iniiwan niya ang kalahati ng sarili niya. Kapag nakita mo ang kalahating iyon… alam mo na ang gagawin.

Tingnan mo ang palda ng kapitbahay. 👀

Broadcast 13 · After Sign-Off. Kuwentong-bayan (folklore) ng manananggal, ginawa sa low-poly 3D.
#manananggal #aswang #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #pinoyfolklore #reels

Sa Baguio, may hotel na kumakain pa rin ang mga bisita

Dominican Hill, Baguio. Ang lumang Diplomat Hotel: itinayo ng mga Dominikano, pinagtaguan noong giyera, naging hotel, at iniwan sa hamog. Sabi ng mga tagapagbantay, pagkalipas ng hatinggabi, may kumakatok. Tapos, tunog ng mga plato.

Bilangin mo ang mga upuan bago at pagkatapos mamatay ang flashlight. 🕯️

Broadcast 14 · After Sign-Off. Kilalang kuwento ng multo, ginawa sa low-poly 3D. Walang tala ang mga historyador na nangyari ang mga pugot na kuwento. Heritage site ito; igalang ang lugar.
#DiplomatHotel #Baguio #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #ghoststory #reels

Kapag may umiiyak na sanggol sa damuhan… huwag kang hihinto

Huling biyahe. Madilim na daan sa probinsya. May umiiyak na sanggol sa damuhan, nakabalot sa lampin. Siyempre, huminto ang driver. Magaan pa sa una…

Panoorin ulit ang windshield sa dulo. 👶

Broadcast 15 · After Sign-Off. Kuwentong-bayan (folklore) ng tiyanak, ginawa sa low-poly 3D. Kathang-isip ang driver at ang jeep.
#tiyanak #aswang #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #pinoyfolklore #reels

Huwag mong aalisin ang tingin mo sa nurse sa Ward 3

Clark, Pampanga. Nang magsara ang base, naiwan ang ospital. Sabi ng mga bumibisita: mga boses, mga bato mula sa dilim, at isang nurse na nakaputi sa pagitan ng mga kama. Huwag mong aalisin ang tingin mo sa kanya.

Bilangin mo ang mga bato. 👀

Broadcast 16 · After Sign-Off. Kilalang kuwento ng multo, ginawa sa low-poly 3D. Mga ulat at alamat lamang ang mga kababalaghan. Huwag pumasok nang walang pahintulot.
#Clark #Pampanga #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #ghoststory #reels

Kapag tatlong beses mo nang nadaanan ang parehong tindahan… huminto ka

Gabi. Isang tricycle. Isang daang napapalibutan ng kawayan. Nadaanan niya ang tindahan ni Aling Nena. Tapos, nadaanan niya ulit. At ulit. Sabi ng mga lola, kapag ganito… huminto ka at baligtarin mo ang damit mo.

Tingnan mo ang presyuhan sa bawat daan. 👀

Broadcast 17 · After Sign-Off. Kuwentong-bayan (folklore) ng tikbalang, ginawa sa low-poly 3D. Kathang-isip ang tindahan at ang rider.
#tikbalang #tabitabipo #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #pinoyfolklore #reels

episodes.story: The Light in the Quezon Room

facebook.caption:
Gabi-gabi, may ilaw sa Malacañang na kusang bumubukas

Malacañang. Sa loob ng maraming henerasyon, iisa ang kuwento ng mga nagtatrabaho roon: isang ilaw na kusang bumubukas, mga yabag sa itaas, usok sa kuwartong walang tao, tawa ng bata sa pasilyo.

Tingnan mo ang upuan sa opisina. Dalawang beses. 🕯️

Broadcast 18 · After Sign-Off. Mga kuwento at alaala ng mga nagtrabaho sa palasyo, iniulat sa mga pahayagan, ginawa sa low-poly 3D. Walang taong pinangalanan.
#Malacanang #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #ghoststory #urbanlegend #reels

Kapag may liwanag na sumusunod sa'yo sa palayan… huwag mo itong sundan

Gabi. Palayan. Isang bola ng apoy na sumasabay sa bawat hakbang mo. Kapag huminto ka, humihinto rin ito. Sabi ng matatanda, kaluluwa raw ito ng nalunod… at dinadala ka nito sa tubig.

Panoorin ang kanal sa unang malawak na kuha. 👀

Broadcast 19 · After Sign-Off. Kuwentong-bayan (folklore) ng santelmo, at ang totoong St. Elmo's fire, ginawa sa low-poly 3D.
#santelmo #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #pinoyfolklore #stelmosfire #reels

Sa teatrong ito, laging may nakaupo sa mga bakanteng upuan

Manila Film Center. Noong Nobyembre 17, 1981, bandang alas tres ng madaling-araw, bumagsak ang scaffolding at nahulog ang mga trabahador sa basang semento. Hanggang ngayon, hindi malinaw kung ilan ang namatay. Mula noon, iisa ang kuwento ng mga guwardiya at performer: puno raw ang mga upuan pagpatay ng ilaw.

Panoorin ang unang segundo. Bilangin ang mga upuang nakababa. 🕯️

Broadcast 20 · After Sign-Off. Season finale. Totoong aksidente; alamat lamang ang mga multo. Inaalala namin ang mga trabahador at ang kanilang mga pamilya.
#ManilaFilmCenter #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #ghoststory #urbanlegend #reels

episodes.note: Real accident on 17 November 1981: never post on 17 November unless as a remembrance.

facebook.caption:
Watch the chair. Not the bed.

Enfield, north London, 1977. A family reported knocking inside the walls. A police officer said she watched a chair slide across the floor by itself. Investigators recorded the house for over a year, and some of them concluded the children had faked it.

Watch the chair. Then watch it again. 🪑

Broadcast 21 · After Sign-Off · Season 3: real cases from around the world. A reconstruction in pixel 3D; no real recordings are used. What was reported is disputed, and the video says so.
#Enfield #poltergeist #ghoststory #truehorror #haunted #reels

Her hair was short. Once.

Hokkaido, Japan. In 1938 a family moving away left a doll at a temple. They called her Okiku. The temple says her hair, short at first, has grown about 25 centimetres, and grows back when it is trimmed. Skeptics say old hair can relax and stretch, or that someone is doing it.

Watch her face. Then go back to the first second. 🎎

Broadcast 22 · After Sign-Off · Season 3: real cases from around the world. A reconstruction in pixel 3D with an original doll; the head turning is our dramatisation.
#Okiku #hauntedoll #japan #ghoststory #truehorror #reels

They were burying him when something laughed

Adams, Tennessee, 1817 to 1821. A farm family reported scratching on the walls, covers pulled off the children's beds, and a voice that talked for three years. When John Bell was buried, witnesses said it laughed over his grave.

Told backwards. Then watch it again. 🕯️

Broadcast 23 · After Sign-Off · Season 3: real cases from around the world. A reconstruction in pixel 3D. Almost all of the story comes from one book written 70 years later, and the family's own account has never been found.
#BellWitch #Tennessee #ghoststory #truehorror #haunted #reels

Don't look at the dolls. They're already looking at you.

Xochimilco, Mexico City. For about fifty years, Don Julián Santana Barrera lived alone on a tiny island in the canals and hung hundreds of dolls in the trees, for a girl he said drowned nearby. No record of her has been found. He died in 2001, in the same canal, his family says.

Watch the dolls on the way out. Then on the way back. 🪆

Broadcast 24 · After Sign-Off · Season 3: real cases from around the world. A reconstruction in pixel 3D. The island is a family-run site; please be respectful.
#IslandOfTheDolls #IslaDeLasMuñecas #Xochimilco #ghoststory #truehorror #reels

This fire door is locked. Watch it.

Hampton Court Palace, October 2003. Three days running, the same fire doors flew open by themselves. On the second day, the palace's own CCTV recorded a figure in a long robe, with a pale face, step out of the doorway and pull the doors shut. The palace released the footage. It has never explained it.

Watch camera three. 📹

Broadcast 25 · After Sign-Off · Season 3: real cases from around the world. A reconstruction in pixel 3D, not the real footage. Skeptics say it was a visitor in costume or a prank.
#HamptonCourt #CCTV #ghoststory #truehorror #haunted #reels

Control, this is Post Three. Someone is running in the corridor.

The Castle of Good Hope, Cape Town: South Africa's oldest colonial building. Guards and staff report footsteps in the corridors, a tall man leaning over the battlements, and a woman in grey running through the passages. In 1729, the story goes, Governor van Noodt sentenced seven soldiers to hang, and was found dead in his chair the same day. History says it was his heart.

Watch the radio. 📻

Broadcast 26 · After Sign-Off · Season 3: real cases from around the world. A reconstruction in pixel 3D; the guard is a composite. The hauntings are reported, not proven.
#CastleOfGoodHope #CapeTown #ghoststory #truehorror #haunted #reels

We set the ball down. Nobody touched it.

Waverly Hills Sanatorium, Louisville, Kentucky: a tuberculosis hospital where thousands of patients died before there was a cure. Investigators leave a ball on the third floor. They say a little boy plays with it. They call him Timmy. No record of him has ever been found.

Watch the ball. Then watch the dark. ⚽

Broadcast 27 · After Sign-Off · Season 3: real cases from around the world. A reconstruction in pixel 3D. The death toll is disputed; the "63,000" figure is legend.
#WaverlyHills #Louisville #ghoststory #truehorror #haunted #reels

The most famous ghost photograph ever taken

Raynham Hall, Norfolk, 19 September 1936. Two Country Life photographers were photographing the great staircase. The assistant said he saw a shape like vapour coming down the stairs, slowly becoming a woman. He shouted to take it. The photographer saw nothing. The print shows a veiled figure on the stairs. Experts said the negative had not been touched. Skeptics say double exposure.

Watch it develop. 📷

Broadcast 28 · After Sign-Off · Season 3: real cases from around the world. A reconstruction in pixel 3D, not the 1936 photograph.
#BrownLady #RaynhamHall #ghostphoto #ghoststory #truehorror #reels

You're the overnight guest. It's 2:58.

Monte Cristo Homestead, Junee, New South Wales. Built in the 1880s by the Crawley family. Mr Crawley died here in 1910; his wife stayed on and rarely left the house again. For decades, overnight guests reported footsteps on the balcony, voices, being touched. Nothing has ever been proven. The house closed to visitors in 2025.

You're the overnight guest. Turn the camera around. 📱

Broadcast 29 · After Sign-Off · Season 3: real cases from around the world. A reconstruction in pixel 3D. The house is private property; please respect it.
#MonteCristo #Junee #haunted #ghoststory #truehorror #reels

They say no one comes back from Poveglia.

Poveglia, the Venetian Lagoon. The legend says 160,000 plague victims, soil made of ash, a doctor who fell from the bell tower. The record says: a quarantine station for ships from 1793, a hospital until 1968, then nothing. Historians can't find the doctor, or the 160,000.

So who's in the boat? 🛶

Broadcast 30 · After Sign-Off · Season 3 finale: real cases from around the world. A reconstruction in pixel 3D. The island is closed to visitors; please don't try.
#Poveglia #Venice #haunted #ghoststory #truehorror #reels

Walang tao sa selda. Pero may kumakagat sa kanya.

Manila City Jail, Mayo 1953. Isang dalagitang nagngangalang Clarita ang sumisigaw gabi-gabi: may kumakagat daw sa kanya. Dalawa raw sila. Ayon sa mga ulat noon, nakita ng mga doktor ang mga marka, at sinabi ng mayor ng Maynila sa mga reporter na nakita niya ito. May mga doktor na nagsabing nasa isip lang ito.

Panoorin ang unang segundo. Ilan ang kagat? 🕯️

Broadcast 31 · After Sign-Off. Season 4: mga kuwentong lokal. Batay sa mga ulat; ang ilang eksena ay dramatisasyon.
#ClaritaVillanueva #Bilibid #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #truestory #reels

Tatlong katok, sa hatinggabi

Kumakatok. Sa mga lumang kuwento, tatlo silang naglalakad sa hatinggabi, nakabalabal, at kumakatok nang tatlong beses. Buksan mo man o hindi, may mamamatay sa bahay na iyon. Kaya noon, gumuguhit ang mga tao ng puting krus sa pinto.

Bilangin ang mga kandila sa unang segundo. 🕯️

Broadcast 32 · After Sign-Off. Season 4: mga kuwentong lokal. Isang alamat; dramatisasyon ang video.
#Kumakatok #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #pamahiin #urbanlegend #reels

Hindi ka makagalaw. Igalaw mo ang daliri ng paa mo.

Batibat. Sa mga Ilokano, isang matandang espiritu na nakatira sa puno. Kapag ginawang haligi ng bahay ang puno, sumasama raw siya, at dinadaganan ang natutulog sa tabi nito. Bangungot naman ang tawag ng iba: sa isang pag-aaral sa Maynila, halos lahat ng namatay sa pagtulog ay mga lalaki, kadalasan bandang alas tres ng madaling-araw.

Kung nangyayari ito sa iyo, magpatingin sa doktor. 🕯️

Broadcast 33 · After Sign-Off. Season 4: mga kuwentong lokal. Alamat at totoong kondisyon; dramatisasyon ang video.
#Bangungot #Batibat #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #sleepparalysis #reels

Palayo ang mga bakas. Pero papalapit ito.

Sigbin. Sa mga kuwento ng Visayas at Mindanao, naglalakad ito nang paatras, nakayuko ang ulo sa pagitan ng mga hulihang paa. Parang kambing na walang sungay, malalaki ang tainga, at mabaho. Kaya kapag may bakas na palayo sa bahay mo... huwag mo itong sundan.

Tingnan mo kung saan nagsisimula ang mga bakas. 🐾

Broadcast 34 · After Sign-Off. Season 4: mga kuwentong lokal. Isang alamat; dramatisasyon ang video.
#Sigbin #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #aswang #urbanlegend #reels

Humahamog ang salamin ng kabaong. Mula sa loob.

Bakit tayo nagpupuyat sa lamay? Sabi ng matatanda, para bantayan ang bangkay. Sa mga kuwento sa Kabisayaan, may amalanhig: bangkay na bumabangon, matigas ang katawan, kaya diretso lang maglakad. Kapag hinabol ka, tumakbo ka nang paliko-liko.

Tingnan mo ang salamin sa dingding sa alas dos. 🕯️

Broadcast 35 · After Sign-Off. Season 4: mga kuwentong lokal. Isang alamat; dramatisasyon ang video.
#Amalanhig #lamay #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #aswang #reels

Sa salamin, puno ang dyip. Pero ikaw lang ang nakaupo.

Isang alamat sa UP Diliman: gabi na, isa-isang bumababa ang mga pasahero ng Ikot hanggang ikaw na lang. Sa huling hinto, hindi lumingon ang drayber. Mahina lang niyang sinabi: pagdating mo, sunugin mo ang damit mo.

Tingnan mo ang bintana. Ilan ang nakaupo? 🪟

Broadcast 36 · After Sign-Off. Season 4: mga kuwentong lokal. Isang alamat; dramatisasyon ang video.
#Ikot #UPDiliman #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #urbanlegend #reels

Gumalaw ang takip ng kawayan. Mula sa loob.

Sa Siquijor, may lumang paniniwala sa barang: mga insektong ikinukulong sa kawayan at pinapadala sa isang pangalan. Pero karamihan sa mga mananambal ng isla, nanggagamot. Tuwing Sabado de Gloria, nagluluto sila ng gamot sa bundok.

Pakinggan mo ang katahimikan bago siya umubo. 🪲

Broadcast 37 · After Sign-Off. Season 4: mga kuwentong lokal. Paniniwala ito; dramatisasyon ang video.
#Siquijor #barang #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #HolyWeek #reels

FWD: Si Maria Labo, nakabalik na raw. Ingat kayo.

Noong dekada nobenta, kumalat ito sa text: si Maria Labo, nakabalik na raw. Nasa Iloilo raw. Hindi, sa Capiz. Hindi, nandito na raw. Walang biktimang naitala, walang petsa. Tsismis lang na pinapasa-pasa. Pero gabi-gabi, may nanay na nagsasara ng pinto.

Bilangin mo ang FWD. 📱

Broadcast 38 · After Sign-Off. Season 4: mga kuwentong lokal. Isang alamat; dramatisasyon ang video.
#MariaLabo #urbanlegend #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #aswang #reels

Dalawa ang upuan sa tabi ng kama ni Tatay.

Sabi ng matatanda, bago pumanaw ang isang tao, may sumusundo sa kanya. Isang mahal sa buhay na nauna na. Apat na gabi akong nagbantay kay Tatay. Sa ikaapat, hinawakan niya ang kamay ko.

Tingnan mo ang kabilang upuan. 🪑

Broadcast 39 · After Sign-Off. Season 4: mga kuwentong lokal. Isang paniniwala; dramatisasyon ang video.
#sundo #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #pamahiin #reels

Patayin ang ilaw.

Corregidor. Noong 1942, naging ospital ang Malinta Tunnel ng mga sugatang Pilipino at Amerikano. Noong 1945, may mga sundalong Hapon na nakulong sa loob, at may mga pagsabog; may mga lagusang hindi na binuksan. Sa night tour, may isang hiling ang gabay: patayin ang ilaw.

Bilangin mo ang ilaw sa unang segundo. 🔦

Para sa lahat ng namatay rito, sa lahat ng panig.

Broadcast 40 · After Sign-Off. Season 4 finale: mga kuwentong lokal. Kasaysayan at mga kuwento ng bisita; dramatisasyon ang video.
#Corregidor #MalintaTunnel #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #history #reels

Labing-isa kami sa UV. Sa bintana, labintatlo.

Alas-dos ng madaling-araw, huling UV pauwi. Sa tabi ko, dalawang babae. Sa bawat lubak, umuuga kaming lahat. Sila, hindi.

Bilangin mo ang ulo sa bintana sa unang segundo. 🚐

Broadcast 41 · After Sign-Off. Season 5: mga kuwento nila. Batay sa mga karanasang ibinahagi online; isinalaysay muli sa sarili naming salita. Dramatisasyon; walang inaangking napatunayan.
#kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #UVExpress #truescarystories #reels

Tumatabi na lang ako. Para makalabas siya.

Gabi-gabi, alas-tres, bumababa ang elevator galing sa ikalabing-apat na palapag. Matagal nang sarado ang palapag na 'yon.

Tingnan mo ang listahan ng palapag sa monitor. May kulang. 🛗

Broadcast 42 · After Sign-Off. Season 5: mga kuwento nila. Batay sa mga karanasang ibinahagi online; isinalaysay muli sa sarili naming salita. Dramatisasyon; walang inaangking napatunayan.
#kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #securityguard #nightshift #reels

Sumama pala siya.

Alas-dos ng madaling-araw sa call center, may batang tumatakbo sa ilalim ng mga mesa. "Jun-Jun" ang tawag sa kanya ng mga matagal na. Nag-resign ako at lumipat. Sumama pala siya.

Panoorin ang itim na monitor. 🎧

Broadcast 43 · After Sign-Off. Season 5: mga kuwento nila. Batay sa mga karanasang ibinahagi online; isinalaysay muli sa sarili naming salita. Dramatisasyon; walang inaangking napatunayan.
#kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #callcenter #graveyardshift #reels

Sumunod ang katok pauwi.

Pag-uwi galing sa lamay ni Lolo, may kumakatok gabi-gabi. Sa harap. Sa kusina. Sa kuwarto nina Mama. Ngayong gabi, sa pinto ko na.

Bilangin mo ang mga pinto. 🚪

Broadcast 44 · After Sign-Off. Season 5: mga kuwento nila. Batay sa mga karanasang ibinahagi online; isinalaysay muli sa sarili naming salita. Dramatisasyon; walang inaangking napatunayan.
#kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #lamay #katok #reels

Huwag kang lilingon sa CR.

Night class, lumang building. Mag-isa ako sa CR nang may humaplos sa buhok ko. Dahan-dahan. Parang nanay. Hindi ako lumingon. Tumingin ako sa salamin.

Tingnan mo ang huling cubicle sa unang segundo. 🪞

Broadcast 45 · After Sign-Off. Season 5: mga kuwento nila. Batay sa mga karanasang ibinahagi online; isinalaysay muli sa sarili naming salita. Dramatisasyon; walang inaangking napatunayan.

Bente-tres kami. Bente-kuwatro ang bilang.
